title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann LeCun, Leon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition in Proceedings of the IEEE. The paper reviews gradient-based learning for document recognition, describes convolutional neural networks for two-dimensional shape variability, and presents graph transformer networks for globally trained multimodule recognition systems.
significance: A documented historical publication milestone for convolutional neural-network and end-to-end document-recognition methods.
